title: East Austin Renewal & Waller Creek Funding
summary:
*   Received an update on urban renewal efforts, including property acquisition and relocation in areas like East 11th and 12th Streets.
*   A planned presentation on community efforts to establish a new hospital/healthcare district was postponed.
*   Discussed funding options for the Waller Creek tunnel project and potential alternative uses for its bond proceeds.
transcript:
MINUTES OF CITY COUNCIL WORK SESSION 
OCTOBER 30,2002
Austin City Council
MINUTES
WORKSESSION
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 30,2002
The following represents the actions taken by the Austin City Council in the order they occurred
during the meeting.
The City Council of Austin, Texas convened in a Work Session on Wednesday, October 30, 2002 at
One Texas Center, 505 Barton Springs Road, 3RD Floor Training Room, Austin, Texas.
Mayor Garcia called the meeting to order at 10:08 a.m.
Briefings
1. 
Update on the Urban Renewal Agency of the City of Austin's activities, accomplishments
and goals related to acquisition, relocation and property disposition in the East 11th and
12th Streets Urban Renewal Area and other renewal areas.
The presentation was made by Ben M. Sifuentes, Chairman of the Board.
2. 
Presentation by members of the Hospital District Steering Committee regarding
community effort to form a hospital/healthcare district.
This item was postponed to November 6,2002.
3. 
Briefing on the funding options for constructing the Waller Creek tunnel and on alternate
options for use of the related bond proceeds.
The presentation was made by John Stephens, Acting Assistant City Manager, and
Mike Heitz, Director, Watershed Protection & Development Review.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 11:31 a.m. was approved on Council Member
Slusher's motion, Council Member Wynn's second on a 6-0 vote. Council Member Thomas
was absent.
The minutes for October 30, 2002 were approved on November 7, 2002 on Council Member
Wynn's motion, Council Member Slusher's second on a 7-0 vote.
